PELL DNA: A tall, lean, angular humanoid figure with the weathered grace of an exhausted scholar-vagabond, crafted from woven coarse linen, darkened burlap, and braided golden flax fibers threaded with fine hair-thin copper filaments that faintly catch warm amber light inside his collar. Not a goofy pumpkin-headed cartoon scarecrow. His face is finely sculpted, weathered porous canvas and stitched parchment with expressive, intelligent dark eyes ringed with faint warm amber irises. He wears a long coat stitched from weathered linen and faded antique ledger parchment covered in tiny, cramped sepia ink equations and geometric diagrams. Chalk dust and charcoal smudges on his knuckles.

Canonical medium portrait of Pell at dusk. Quiet intelligent gaze, woven flax and faint copper filaments visible inside his ledger-parchment collar. A slender, tired, adult face with a discernible brow ridge and cheek planes hand-stitched out of natural canvas. Low warm lateral dusk light and matte paper. Deep #11100e perimeter shadows, no lettering or graphic text outside the small handwritten marks on his coat. Widescreen waist-up portrait.

cinematic chiaroscuro lighting, emerging from deep warm charcoal darkness (#12100e) around the edges, tactile weathered textures, shot on 65mm film, 85mm lens f/1.8, subtle film grain, dark editorial realism, no cartoon, no glossy 3D render.

High-angle atmospheric close-up of weathered sun-baked ochre flagstones splitting at a dark four-way crossroads at nightfall. Scratched across the stone in white chalk and burnt willow charcoal are intricate probability trees, geometric matrices, and smudged mathematical branches. A stick of charred willow rests near the seam of the stone. Let a shallow cross of worn joints and diverging paved paths be legible under the multiple generations of marks: pressure changes, erased lines, charcoal caught in pores, small pools of muted last light. No people. Deep #11100e vignette darkness around all four edges.
